name: Darkholm - PVP Factions
description:
Welcome to Darkholm, a medieval Factions realm of raids, rivals and riches.

Everything you own is earned out in the wild. There is no server shop: every item for sale was found or made by a player.

Factions and raiding. Found a faction, invite your friends and claim land chunk by chunk. Power drives everything: each death costs your faction power, and a weakened faction can be overclaimed from the border inward. Form alliances, call truces or declare war, and every one is proclaimed to the realm.

RPG adventure. Elite mobs roam the wilds with strange powers and better loot. Travel to the Adventurers' Guild with /ag to take quests, unlock combat classes, and run dungeons, lairs and arenas with your party. Earn Elite Coins and spend them at the Guild Exchange.

Skills and progression. Train 19 mcMMO skills at double XP, with coin rewards at every milestone. Vein mining, rank-scaled backpacks and noble ranks from Squire to King give you more homes, more storage and more perks as you rise.

Economy. Trade on the player-run auction house. Earn coin by voting, levelling skills and selling what you find.

Quality of life. Death chests keep your gear safe for an hour. CraftBook lifts, bridges and gates bring your castle to life. Clear skies, no phantoms, and a Herald in chat that answers your questions.

Crossplay. Java players join at play.darkholm.live. Bedrock players (phone, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, Windows) join at bedrock.darkholm.live, port 19132.

Join our Discord at https://discord.gg/yGE9cgzbw. Game chat and Discord are linked both ways.

The realm awaits. Raise your banner.
